title: Project Funnel (raw → AMA / TP OTT → pool → before_llm → after_llm → ott → tickets)

list.name: service
list.label: Project
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT service FROM events WHERE type = 'scenario.completed' ORDER BY service;

targets.rawSql: SELECT avg((payload->'scenario'->>'raw_proposals_count')::int)::int AS value FROM events WHERE service IN ($service) AND type='scenario.completed' AND payload->'scenario'->>'raw_proposals_count' IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(received_at);

panels.title: 2. AMA (предложения)

targets.rawSql: SELECT avg(COALESCE((payload->'scenario'->>'ama_proposals_count')::int, (payload->'scenario'->>'merged_count')::int))::int AS value FROM events WHERE service IN ($service) AND type='scenario.completed' AND $__timeFilter(received_at) AND COALESCE((payload->'scenario'->>'ama_proposals_count')::int, (payload->'scenario'->>'merged_count')::int) IS NOT NULL;

panels.description: Предложения AMA до фильтров (ama_proposals_count; до 29.05.2026 — merged_count, он тогда был равен строкам AMA). merged_count с digital-assistant-2.0 #611 = AMA + TP OTT, поэтому здесь не используется.

targets.rawSql: SELECT avg((payload->'scenario'->>'viable_count')::int)::int AS value FROM events WHERE service IN ($service) AND type='scenario.completed' AND payload->'scenario'->>'viable_count' IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(received_at);

SELECT avg((payload->'scenario'->>'tickets_shown')::int)::numeric(10,1) AS value FROM events WHERE service IN ($service) AND type='scenario.completed' AND payload->'scenario'->>'tickets_shown' IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(received_at);

panels.title: Воронка средних значений

targets.rawSql: SELECT '1. Raw proposals (TP, все партнёры)' AS stage, avg((payload->'scenario'->>'raw_proposals_count')::int)::int AS avg FROM events WHERE service IN ($service) AND type='scenario.completed' AND $__timeFilter(received_at) UNION ALL SELECT '2. AMA proposals' AS stage, avg(COALESCE((payload->'scenario'->>'ama_proposals_count')::int, (payload->'scenario'->>'merged_count')::int))::int AS avg FROM events WHERE service IN ($service) AND type='scenario.completed' AND $__timeFilter(received_at) UNION ALL SELECT '3. TP OTT (партнёр 20)' AS stage, avg((payload->'scenario'->>'tp_ott_proposals_count')::int)::int AS avg FROM events WHERE service IN ($service) AND type='scenario.completed' AND $__timeFilter(received_at) UNION ALL SELECT '4. Merged pool (TP+AMA)' AS stage, avg((payload->'scenario'->>'merged_pool_count')::int)::int AS avg FROM events WHERE service IN ($service) AND type='scenario.completed' AND $__timeFilter(received_at) UNION ALL SELECT '5. Before LLM (code-filters)' AS stage, avg((payload->'scenario'->>'before_llm_count')::int)::int AS avg FROM events WHERE service IN ($service) AND type='scenario.completed' AND $__timeFilter(received_at) UNION ALL SELECT '6. After LLM' AS stage, avg((payload->'scenario'->>'after_llm_count')::int)::int AS avg FROM events WHERE service IN ($service) AND type='scenario.completed' AND $__timeFilter(received_at) UNION ALL SELECT '7. After OTT whitelist' AS stage, avg((payload->'scenario'->>'after_ott_whitelist_count')::int)::int AS avg FROM events WHERE service IN ($service) AND type='scenario.completed' AND $__timeFilter(received_at) UNION ALL SELECT '8. Tickets shown' AS stage, avg((payload->'scenario'->>'tickets_shown')::int)::int AS avg FROM events WHERE service IN ($service) AND type='scenario.completed' AND $__timeFilter(received_at) ORDER BY 1;

panels.description: TP OTT (tp_ott_proposals_count) пишется с digital-assistant-2.0 #611; в окне до выкатки среднее считается только по новым поискам.

targets.rawSql: SELECT (avg(100.0 * (payload->'scenario'->>'tickets_shown')::int / NULLIF((payload->'scenario'->>'raw_proposals_count')::int, 0)))::numeric(10,2) AS value FROM events WHERE service IN ($service) AND type='scenario.completed' AND payload->'scenario'->>'raw_proposals_count' IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(received_at);

SELECT received_at AS "Время", service AS "Service", data AS "Запрос", (payload->'scenario'->>'raw_proposals_count')::int AS "Raw", COALESCE((payload->'scenario'->>'ama_proposals_count')::int, (payload->'scenario'->>'merged_count')::int) AS "AMA", (payload->'scenario'->>'tp_ott_proposals_count')::int AS "TP OTT", (payload->'scenario'->>'merged_pool_count')::int AS "Pool", (payload->'scenario'->>'before_llm_count')::int AS "BeforeLLM", (payload->'scenario'->>'after_llm_count')::int AS "AfterLLM", (payload->'scenario'->>'after_ott_whitelist_count')::int AS "AfterOTT", (payload->'scenario'->>'tickets_shown')::int AS "Tickets", CASE WHEN (payload->'scenario'->>'raw_proposals_count')::int > 0 THEN round(100.0 * (payload->'scenario'->>'tickets_shown')::int / (payload->'scenario'->>'raw_proposals_count')::int, 2) END AS "% конв." FROM events WHERE service IN ($service) AND type='scenario.completed' AND $__timeFilter(received_at) ORDER BY received_at DESC LIMIT 100;

panels.title: tickets=0: где обрыв воронки (причина)

targets.rawSql: SELECT received_at AS "Время", concat(payload->'scenario'->>'origin','-',payload->'scenario'->>'destination') AS "Маршрут", (payload->'scenario'->>'raw_proposals_count')::int AS "Raw", COALESCE((payload->'scenario'->>'ama_proposals_count')::int, (payload->'scenario'->>'merged_count')::int) AS "AMA", (payload->'scenario'->>'tp_ott_proposals_count')::int AS "TP OTT", (payload->'scenario'->>'merged_pool_count')::int AS "Pool", (payload->'scenario'->>'before_llm_count')::int AS "BeforeLLM", (payload->'scenario'->>'after_llm_count')::int AS "AfterLLM", (payload->'scenario'->>'after_ott_whitelist_count')::int AS "AfterOTT", CASE   WHEN payload->'scenario'->>'tickets_zero_reason' = 'ama_failed_tp_empty' THEN 'ama_failed (сбой AMA, у TP нет OTT)'   WHEN payload->'scenario'->>'tickets_zero_reason' = 'tp_partial_failed' THEN 'tp_failed (часть поисков TP упала)'   WHEN payload->'scenario'->>'before_llm_count' IS NULL AND received_at < '2026-06-03 18:00+00' THEN '(до funnel-деплоя)'   WHEN payload->'scenario'->>'before_llm_count' IS NULL AND COALESCE(COALESCE((payload->'scenario'->>'ama_proposals_count')::int, (payload->'scenario'->>'merged_count')::int), 0) = 0 AND (COALESCE((payload->'scenario'->>'ama_failed_count')::int, 0) > 0 OR jsonb_array_length(COALESCE(payload->'scenario'->'ama_error_types', '[]'::jsonb)) > 0) THEN 'ama_failed (сбой AMA, у TP нет OTT)'   WHEN payload->'scenario'->>'before_llm_count' IS NULL AND COALESCE(COALESCE((payload->'scenario'->>'ama_proposals_count')::int, (payload->'scenario'->>'merged_count')::int), 0) = 0 AND COALESCE((payload->'scenario'->>'raw_proposals_count')::int, 0) > 0 THEN 'no_ott (AMA пуста, у TP только сторонние партнёры)'   WHEN payload->'scenario'->>'before_llm_count' IS NULL AND COALESCE(COALESCE((payload->'scenario'->>'ama_proposals_count')::int, (payload->'scenario'->>'merged_count')::int), 0) = 0 THEN 'no_data (AMA и TP пусты)'   WHEN payload->'scenario'->>'before_llm_count' IS NULL THEN '(нет данных воронки)'   WHEN (payload->'scenario'->>'merged_pool_count')::int = 0 THEN 'no_data (нет proposals)'   WHEN (payload->'scenario'->>'before_llm_count')::int = 0 THEN 'code-filter (killer/даты)'   WHEN (payload->'scenario'->>'after_llm_count')::int = 0 THEN 'LLM-killer'   WHEN (payload->'scenario'->>'after_ott_whitelist_count')::int = 0 THEN 'OTT-whitelist (structural)'   ELSE 'render/ranking' END AS "Причина", payload->'scenario'->>'ama_empty_reasons' AS "AMA пусто", (payload->'scenario'->>'ama_proxy_failures_count')::int AS "Сбои прокси AMA" FROM events WHERE service IN ($service) AND type='scenario.completed' AND (payload->'scenario'->>'tickets_shown')::int = 0 AND $__timeFilter(received_at) ORDER BY received_at DESC LIMIT 50;

panels.description: AMA пусто: почему AMA ответила без билетов (no_data — рейсов нет, no_round_trip — на туда-обратно только билеты в одну сторону, no_one_way — наоборот). TP OTT, AMA пусто и сбои прокси пишутся с digital-assistant-2.0 #611. Причина без данных воронки (before_llm_count пуст): no_ott — у TP нет предложений OneTwoTrip, правило «только OTT» отсекает всё; no_data — оба источника пусты; ama_failed — сбой AMA (по tickets_zero_reason или, у старых поисков, по ama_failed_count / ama_error_types), tp_failed — часть поисков TP упала.
